title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
statement_short: Given two integer arrays preorder and inorder where preorder is the preorder traversal of a binary tree and inorder is the inorder traversal of the same tree, construct and return the binary tree.
constraints: 1 <= preorder.length <= 3000, inorder.length == preorder.length, -3000 <= preorder[i], inorder[i] <= 3000, preorder and inorder consist of unique values
hint: Unique values and length <= 3000 allow using a hash map for inorder index lookups to divide and conquer subtrees in O(n) time.
keywords: preorder traversal of a binary tree
inorder traversal of the same tree
why_not: Right: Tree DFS uses preorder elements as roots and splits inorder index segments via a hash map to recursively build left and right subtrees in O(n) time. Not Tree BFS: Level-order traversal queue logic cannot easily reconstruct tree topology from preorder root sequences. Not HashMap / Hash Set: HashMap accelerates index lookups, but the fundamental tree construction logic is recursive DFS division. Not Backtracking: Tree construction follows a deterministic split based on index lookups, requiring no exhaustive path searching.
